verdict.line: You lose if you feed Mordekaiser three landed hits and let Darkness Rise snowball the trade; you win if you all-in while Obliterate is down and deny his stacks with Valor.

brief.thesis: This lane is decided by Mordekaiser's passive: Darkness Rise only turns on after he lands 3 hits on you, so every trade is a race to either deny that third hit or to burst him before it matters. The 50.1% win rate over 335 games confirms this is genuinely even, not a lane you should play scared in.

theirWindow.what: Do not walk into the third poke. Use E (Valor) to dash through and block the hit that would proc Darkness Rise, or disengage entirely — once his aura and Move Speed kick in he out-trades you clean.

yourWindow.what: At early ranks that's an 8s window with no poke coming back. Close the gap with Q (Broken Wings), land W (Ki Burst) to stun, and dump auto-attacks empowered by Runic Blade before he can reset.

start.why: Runs in 89.8% of games at a 51.5% win rate. The AD and sustain let you trade into his auto-attacks without needing to land a perfect combo every time.

boots.why: Highest picked and best performing boots (51.8% over 228 games). Lower cooldowns on Q/W/E mean more windows to catch his Obliterate on cooldown.

core.why: Best-performing opener in this matchup, 82.1% win rate over the full path. Cooldown refund on R lets you threaten Wind Slash more than once per fight.
Sustained damage and healing to keep pace with his Indestructible shield-heal loop over a long lane.
Damage-over-time conversion softens his burst from Obliterate and keeps you alive through his passive aura ticks.

situational.when: he's ahead and his magic burst from Obliterate is threatening to one-shot you off cooldown
he builds into a tankier late-game teamfight profile and you need to shred through it

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through your extended Q-W-E trades and the healing it grants directly offsets what he banks into Indestructible, so you're not just losing a sustain war by default.

summoners.why: Run in 98% of games at 50.9% win rate. Ignite cuts through his Indestructible heal-back, which is the only way to close out a kill once he starts banking shield value.

playing.title: Block the third hit, not the first
playing.detail: Darkness Rise only activates after 3 landed hits. Track the count and use Valor's damage block specifically to deny the proc, not just to soak random poke.

playing.title: All-in when Obliterate is down
playing.detail: His Q is 8/7/6/5/4s on cooldown and is his main threat at range 675. The moment it's used, close the gap — he has nothing else to punish your engage until it's back up.

playing.title: Fight in minions, not in the open
playing.detail: Obliterate deals increased damage when it hits a single target. Trading with minions nearby means you're not eating the bonus damage every cast.

playing.title: Respect level 6 all-ins
playing.detail: Realm of Death isolates you in a straight duel and steals your stats if he kills you. Don't extend a trade below half HP once he has it up.

playing.title: Track his ultimate cooldown
playing.detail: Realm of Death is 140/90/... down to 90s by rank 3. Once he's used it and whiffed or you've survived it, that's your green light to play aggressive again.

playing.title: Save Wind Slash for the punish
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile grants one ranged Wind Slash. Hold it to finish a trade or catch him mid-Death's Grasp animation rather than throwing it early.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and the 50.1% head-to-head win rate over 335 games are pulled from measured OP.GG data on the current patch. The trade timings and passive-denial reading are my own analysis, built from the raw ability cooldowns and effects.
